BiblicalUsage: ṭumʼâh is the word for uncleanness, impurity. In Leviticus 5:3, Or if he touch the uncleanness of man. The word turns up 31 times, and each time it points to the same reality.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe uncleanness in Scripture is never only about the body; it shows me how seriously God takes what defiles His people. That is why I come back to ṭumʼâh whenever I need to remember what is true.
